pkgmetadata.longdescription: A drop-in replacement for app-containers/waydroid that patches the waydroid Python application and ships pre-built host and guest GPU driver stacks to enable full NVIDIA GPU acceleration in the Android container. The host side runs a Mesa Venus vtest render server; the guest side uses a Mesa Venus Vulkan HAL and ANGLE OpenGL-over-Vulkan to forward all rendering to the host NVIDIA driver over a Unix socket. Supports GTX 900 through RTX 50 series cards via the nvidia-open kernel modules.
